name: Turntide Contributor Knowledge Market
promise: Contributors can deliberately license bounded experiential knowledge to TTI, retain provenance through derived Union products, and receive non-transferable contribution credits when externally settled sales use their admitted contribution.

discordForbidden: treating server participation as a contribution license
AI training on API message content without Discord express permission
platformBoundary.rule: A contributor must re-state or upload their own knowledge at TTI's direct boundary; a Discord message ID may be a private discovery pointer but its content is never imported as the commercial contribution.
platformBoundary.intakeSecurity: Offer links are opaque, expire after 30 minutes, are hashed at rest, are not consumed by GET, and may commit one pending-admission candidate. TTI and its HTTPS proxy must suppress query strings from access logs.

discordIntentTrigger.effect: Every human mention enters the private operational roster; only explicit sell/contribute language creates a contribution-offer session and DM one-time direct-TTI-intake link.
discordIntentTrigger.notEffect: A mention alone is not a knowledge-offer request, contribution, license, sale, assignment, payment, or consent to commercialize Discord/API content.
discordIntentTrigger.expiry: The opaque direct-intake session expires after 30 minutes and may be consumed once. A repeated mention may request a fresh session.

firstRevenueProduct.acquisitionFunnel: free Discord answer interest to persistent Knowledge Vault retention or cost-grounded metered MCP/A2A power-user service

allows: agent retrieval under the sale license
agent retrieval under the sale license
forbids: uses outside the contribution's declared subject and contexts

allocation.formula: matured pool = floor((settled gross sale receipt - receipted payment processing - receipted direct provider fulfillment cost - matured refunds and chargebacks) * 5000 / 10000); each contribution receives floor(pool * attributionWeightPpm / 1000000)
allocation.weightRule: Every sale contract freezes normalized contribution attribution weights totaling 1,000,000 ppm before delivery; weights are assigned to epistemic contribution, not message count or claim splitting.
allocation.maturityRule: Credits post only after the disclosed refund/chargeback window; unpaid, reversed, estimated, or cost-incomplete sales allocate nothing.
allocation.payoutStatus: blocked pending tax, payment, minimum-threshold, unclaimed-property, and contributor-contract review

sensitiveDataRefusals: minor contributor without a separate lawful guardian process
content whose contributor cannot grant the selected rights

commercial.profitRule: TTI profit is its retained settled margin after contributor credits and attributable costs

activationAdmission.pilotScope: broker mention and direct pending-candidate intake only; no sale or payout authority
activationAdmission.rule: Runtime activation requires a distinct unexpired admitted record binding every required evidence check, the exact effective terms ID, and the production HTTPS origin.
